Admission Procedure Congratulations on your decision to consider SAGE University Indore (SUI) in your college search. In the Office of Admissions, we want to support your exploration of the countless opportunities available to you at SUI. I would personally like to invite you to engage with us. To make sure you can get all of your questions answered, we have appointed an admission counselor for your area. I strongly encourage you to reach out and introduce yourself, so we can support you through this exciting and important time in your life. You can also schedule a campus visit or register for a program to learn more about SUI in person. The faculty members at SUI have a rich blend of academic and corporate experience and thus use the teaching pedagogy, which helps you visualize the concept for application in the real world. The mentoring process adopted by the faculty mentors helps you introspect your strengths and area of interest to further improve your place-ability score. The corporate relation cell (CRC) at SUI ensures the best corporate interface to expose students to the various activities of the corporate world, be it related to knowledge, skill, or attitude. CRC contributions in SUI transform students into professionals with better opportunities in the corporate world. Sage University Indore is now accepting SAT Scores by College Board for admissions to UG Programmes. Send us your scores directly, by using Score send Code: 30737 Admissions to various programs of the SAGE University are based on entrance exam i.e Joint Entrance Examination – , or Qualifying Examination Merit (i.e. class X/XII/UG/PG result) or as stipulated by Statutory Authority concerned. Applicants seeking admission to UG/PG/Ph.D. programs must register themselves offline or online on the admission portal. The procedure for the same is mentioned below: SAGE admission team will communicate with you the date and timing of course counseling subject to the submission of an online/offline counseling fee of Rs. 1600/- in favor of SAGE University. After registration students need to appear in “Joint Entrance Examination- SAGE JEE (SEE)”. Admission to all the programs is based upon the SEE test or eligibility exam merit base. Demand Draft (DD) should is in favour of “Registrar, Sage University” payable at Indore. h3 Message from, Head Ph.D. Cell
p Research Learning has to develop research agenda and formulate policies to a quality research culture. Research, at the University, has not to be just a philosophy but the very essence of all its academic endeavors and for further progress of self and to help the others also. The success of a University is greatly depends upon the research orientation of the Research Scholars of Faculty members. In order to contribute to the society by developing new ideas and provide solutions to the challenging problems of current trends, the researcher at the University has to focus on creating of new Ideas
p The faculties as well as Research Scholars of the University are deeply involved in socially relevant research. In order to encourage research within the University and to build a research based University to build culture of new Idea and Innovation.
p We are Sanguine that during the coming years SAGE University will reach the noticeable heights with full cooperation from different Research Centre, Research Laboratories, Professional Bodies, Academicians and Research Alumni under different discipline at large in its endeavor to be the Research based University of Central India.
h3 Dr. Rajiv Arya Professor & Head PhD Cell Sage University, Indore
p Admissions to Ph.D. programs at SAGE University Indore campus are conducted twice a year. A Ph.D. program is offered as Full time program. Hence, coursework, participation in various interactions, submission of progress reports through presentations etc. on regular basis is mandatory during the program.
p A Full-time Ph.D. scholar shall mean a candidate devoting full time for completing the requirements of the program Ph.D. full time is for minimum 3 years and Maximum duration is 6 years.
p SAGE University Indore encourages research and exchange of ideas and knowledge in various related fields. Consequently, scholars may appoint a Co-Guide from outside SAGE University Indore, as per university rules. The main Guide for the scholar during the Ph.D. program will be from SAGE University Indore, appointed as per the research topic and Guide availability.
